transcript:
[melancholic] [solemn]
Aur ek insaan... Billie Holiday. Legendary jazz singer.

[reverent] [grave]
Usne ek gaana gaya... Strange Fruit... lynching ke baare mein. Us zamane ka sabse powerful protest song.

[serious] [authoritative]
Ye historically documented hai ki Anslinger ke bureau ne Billie Holiday ko target kiya... aur ye targeting uski death ke waqt tak chali.

[grave] [indignant]
Historians aur uske biographers ke according... is targeting mein race ek bada factor tha.

[curious] [probing]
Aur medical evidence ka kya?

[authoritative] [scholarly]
Ye documented hai... unnis sau sainttees mein jab cannabis ko criminalize karne ka bill aaya... American Medical Association ke representative Doctor William Woodward ne uske against testify kiya.

[serious] [disappointed]
Unki testimony ko largely ignore kar diya gaya.

[scholarly] [informative]
Us daur ki serious studies... jaise British India ki athaarah sau pachaanve ki Hemp Commission report... cannabis ko relatively harmless bata chuki thi.

[blunt] [grave]
Lekin campaign chalta raha.
